journey.name: Image Carousel & Gallery Lightbox CUJ
journey.description: Verifies multi-image post carousel interaction in feed, boundary swipe isolation, in-feed count indicator, opening full-screen lightbox, swiping images, live index sync, and smooth dismiss transition back to the feed.

actions.action: Verify that the app is open on the Home feed
Locate a multi-image post card in the timeline
Verify that the in-feed image count pill (e.g. 1/3 or 1/4) is visible on the carousel
Swipe left on the post image carousel to view the second image
Verify that the in-feed count pill updates to 2/x
Swipe left past the last image of the carousel
Verify that horizontal drag delta is consumed and the parent feed tab pager does not switch tabs
Tap the active image in the post card to open the full-screen gallery lightbox
Verify that the full-screen lightbox overlay is displayed without a blank black frame
Swipe left to view image 3 in the full-screen lightbox
Tap the Close button or swipe down to dismiss the full-screen lightbox
Verify that the app returns to the feed and the feed carousel is synced to image 3
